h: Sanctifying the Body Through Shabbos and Sacred Eating

p: because he holds on to this one and that one;
בְּמִצְוֹת עֲשֵׂה וּמִצְוֹת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כוּ׳
to positive and negative mitzvos," etc.
For the shelamim are the wholeness of everything;
and it is an eating in holiness.
And so Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
to bring down the attribute of holiness,
"And they will sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov";
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
as is written (in the Ra'aya Mehemna,
וְזֶה מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה יא, ז)
And this is what they said (Bereishis Rabbah 11:7):
יַעֲקֹב שֶׁכָּתוּב בּוֹ שְׁמִירַת שַׁבָּת כוּ׳
"Yaakov, of whom keeping Shabbos is written, etc.,
יָרַשׁ אֶת הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא בְּמִדָּה כוּ׳
inherited the world without measure," etc.
For Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
had holiness from his own side,
for he knew nothing at all
and the Midrash says: what the lightest of the light
rather he intended to bear offspring,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה וּפֵירוּשׁ רַשִׁ״י וַיֵּצֵא)
as Chazal said (Midrash Rabbah, and Rashi on Vayeitzei);
for it did not occur to him
that there is bodily pleasure in this,
so that there should be shame in it,
like Adam HaRishon before the corruption,
And this is the holiness of Shabbos:
and not a day of the body,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רה, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 205b);
of whom keeping Shabbos is written.
was that his bed be complete;
he inherited the world without measure,
(בְּרֵאשִׁית כח, יד) וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְגוֹ׳
(Bereishis 28:14) "and you shall spread out westward and eastward, etc.,"
with the pasuk "Ten, ten per ladle, etc.":
"rather, ten for the act of Creation
and ten for the giving of the Torah";
for the repetition was difficult for it,
which is written of the gold ladles
more than of the silver basins;
that it alludes to ten for the act of Creation
and ten for the giving of the Torah,
That is, the whole world is full of holiness;
just as the ten of the giving of the Torah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ג רצז, א)
so too the ten utterances of Creation
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹקִים וְגוֹ׳ טוֹב מְאֹד וְגוֹ׳
"And God saw, etc., very good, etc.":
that the opposite should become very good.
And this is the matter of shelamim,
which are eaten by the owners:
that the eating and the body
And as for the connection to "a ladle full of ketores":
there is also another difference in the pasuk,
for with the silver bowls and basins
"filled with fine flour" is not mentioned,
while in the text it is written:
בְּמַה שֶּׁאָמַר הַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ לְעֵיל (יא, א)
by what the holy Zohar said above (III 11a):
are eaten by the kohanim, etc.,
and they are the emissaries of the Merciful One,
and eat from the King's table;
לָא חֲבִיבִין קַמֵּי קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
none are as dear before HaKadosh Baruch Hu
and above them all is the ketores,
which is more complete than all, etc.;
is offered only at the time
that the oil is offered," etc.
the ten Names that may not be erased.
against which there are ten Names
and the chelbenah that joins them
and it alludes to the sinners of Yisrael,
as Chazal said (Taanis 15a, end of perek 1);
that is, when the heart becomes straight;
and this is only when it comprises ten,
of the giving of the Torah,
"The precepts of Hashem are upright, gladdening the heart";
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק א רב, א)
in which even the chelbenah gives a good fragrance.
And this is "Oil and ketores gladden the heart."
And the ketores is superior to shelamim,
that even the chelbenah will give a good fragrance,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 184a):
אֶלָּא הַהוּא דְּנָפִיק מִגּוֹ בִּישָׁא וְכוּ׳
except that which emerges from within evil," etc.
that even the body is holy
and the eating is in holiness.
"And you will eat and be satisfied;
it brings this from several pesukim.
And eating that is in holiness
אֵין יֵצֶר הָרָע שׁוֹלֵט עַל יָדוֹ
the yetzer hara does not rule through it.
וְזֶהוּ קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
like Adam HaRishon before the sin;
and this is the holiness of Shabbos,
that the eating is in holiness;
and his reward is that he is given
the inheritance of Yaakov your father, etc.,"
"and you shall spread out westward and eastward, etc."
That is, that holiness should spread
And "a Jew, even though he has sinned,
in which even the chelbenah will give a good fragrance,
that is, even a Jew who sinned.
for the first holiness is mentioned of him,
and it is the holiness of the ketores
which is found in all the works of Creation,
ten for the giving of the Torah,
ten for the act of Creation,
And this is what it says: "gold ladles, etc.,
meaning the holiness of the ketores:
is bound together with the ten spices
which correspond to the ten Names
and it too gives a good fragrance;
and this is the ten of Creation,
And this is the matter of the holiness of Shabbos
that the holy Arizal, of blessed memory, wrote:
is that the eating be for the sake of Heaven,
when one eats for bodily pleasure on Shabbos,
And therefore of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and he inherited the world without measure;
and this is the holiness of the ketores.
there is the spreading of the shelter of peace
over us and over all His people Yisrael
there is the holiness of Eretz Yisrael

— “Then you can seek GOD’s favor. I will set you astride the heights of the earth, And let you enjoy the heritage of your father Jacob—For GOD’s mouth has spoken.”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Sanhedrin 44a — “״חטא ישראל״. אמר רבי אבא בר זבדא: אף על פי שחטא, ישראל הוא. אמר רבי אבא: היינו דאמרי אינשי: אסא דקאי ביני חלפי, אסא שמיה, ואסא קרו ליה.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 98) — “§ When God explained to Joshua the reason for the Jewish people’s defeat at the city of Ai, He said: “Israel has sinned” (Joshua 7:11).
